title: Orange County Mayor (runoff)
what_it_does: The county mayor is the county's chief executive: proposes the budget, oversees county departments and staff, and presides over the Board of County Commissioners.
verified_ballot_note: Runoff lineup and Aug. 18 results from WFTV, Central Florida Public Media (https://www.cfpublic.org/politics/2026-08-18/moore-russell-messina-orange-county-mayor-november-runoff) and Spectrum News 13. Nonpartisan.

candidates.name: Tiffany Moore Russell
candidates.background: Orange County Clerk of Courts. Finished first in the four-way Aug. 18 nonpartisan primary.
candidates.primary_result: First in Aug 18 primary with 32% (53,009 votes)
